review_description: We are getting a 1.8 kw system.
As for the company, they were just terrific to deal with..  and thank you for your additional information that you sent to me. Most helpful.

Still waiting on installation, but to date service and information have all been very good. Local Penrith company with plenty of Government data to back up their sales pitch. Sales person visited my home and was very relaxed and not pushy.
